name: Detrics
description: Query real-time marketing and e-commerce data from 30+ advertising, analytics, CRM and commerce platforms directly through Claude. The only MCP connector with native support for Latin American platforms like MercadoLibre, TiendaNube, and VTEX, alongside global ad and analytics sources: Facebook Ads (Meta Ads), Google Ads, Shopify, TikTok Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, Klaviyo and more. Ask questions in natural language and get cross-platform comparisons instantly. All fields are normalized across platforms for consistent analysis. Supports AI Contexts for pre-configured data source collections. Manage your BigQuery marketing data warehouse. Secured with OAuth 2.0

_published_faq.name: How do I add Detrics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Detrics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.detrics.io/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Detrics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Detrics provides these MCP tools: check_connection_status, connect_platform, get_context, get_warehouse, list_accounts, list_connections, list_contexts, list_fields, manage_warehouse_destination, manage_warehouse_table, manage_warehouse_transfer, and query_marketing_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Detrics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Detrics in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Detrics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Detrics is developed by Detrics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
